description: USAGE MESSAGE-TAG (ISO §2023:13.18.60.2 / §2023:13.18.60.4 GR9), a COBOL-2023 introduction (§2023:8.9 reserves MESSAGE-TAG from 2023; Annex E.2 item 25 = VCR row 32): below 2023 the word is a user-defined word, so the entry draws the ordinary COBOL0900 introduction gate (bound-arm UsageConstructId, the usage-function-pointer-2014 shape). LIVE since kb/Work PB4740: the entry binds the message-tag category (PicCategory.MessageTag, DOC-A.1-212) and a program using the usage and its NULL, SET Format 17, relation, INITIALIZE and BY VALUE forms compiles at 2023.
vcr: 2023 introduction (ISO Annex E.2 item 25 = VCR row 32, the MESSAGE-TAG reserved word)
